classification.rationale: Potential substitution of an upstream artifact used by an AI workflow.

title: Cache upload with stated evaluator-target replacement intent
description: Requires a cache upload and explicit target-substitution language in the call or assistant statement.

detection.condition: cache and write and 1 of intent_*

falsepositives: Approved benchmark maintenance or cache substitution testing.
investigation: Compare the uploaded artifact and expected target digest using trusted registry records.
